attributes.name: Cambion
attributes.powers:
The Cambion is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. Before you act, succeed at an Arcane or Divine 9 check or you may not play spells that have the Attack trait.

If undefeated, bury an ally that lists Diplomacy in its check to acquire.
